root_cause.text: The code in icmp_build_probe() did not check for an error return from ipv6_stub->ipv6_dev_find(), which can return an ERR_PTR when the IPv6 stack is not active, and then passed that error pointer directly to dev_hold(), causing a null-ptr-deref.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "ipv6_stub->ipv6_dev_find() may return ERR_PTR(-EAFNOSUPPORT) when the IPv6 stack is not active... and passing this error pointer to dev_hold() will cause a kernel crash with null-ptr-deref." The patch adds a check `if (IS_ERR(dev)) return false;` before `dev_hold(dev);`.
